name: SP1 — Graceful degradation for recoverable LLM failures

scenarios.name: SP1-GD-01 revision validation failure returns pre-revision CS with warning

steps.text: an LLM that returns an invalid ControlStructure JSON with cross-reference violations
critic findings with unjustified gaps
the revision is run
the pre-revision ControlStructure is returned
the returned warnings include a revision failure message
the pipeline does not crash

scenarios.name: SP1-GD-02 revision failure logs the failed call with success=false

steps.text: an LLM that returns an invalid ControlStructure JSON
critic findings with unjustified gaps
the revision is run
a call log entry is appended with stage stage_2
the call log entry step is revision
the call log entry success is false
the call log entry has an error message field

scenarios.name: SP1-GD-03 revision LLM exception returns pre-revision CS with warning

steps.text: an LLM that raises a RuntimeError during the revision call
critic findings with unjustified gaps
the revision is run
the pre-revision ControlStructure is returned
the returned warnings include a revision failure message
a call log entry is appended with stage stage_2
the call log entry step is revision
the call log entry success is false
the call log entry has an error message field

scenarios.name: SP1-GD-04 critic validation failure returns empty CriticFindings

steps.text: an LLM that returns an invalid CriticFindings JSON
the completeness critic is run
an empty CriticFindings model is returned
the gaps list is empty
the checklist_results dict is empty
the taxonomy_probe_results dict is empty
the pipeline does not crash

scenarios.name: SP1-GD-05 critic failure logs the failed call with success=false

steps.text: an LLM that returns an invalid CriticFindings JSON
the completeness critic is run
a call log entry is appended with stage stage_2
the call log entry step is critic
the call log entry success is false
the call log entry has an error message field

scenarios.name: SP1-GD-06 critic failure does not trigger revision

steps.text: an LLM that returns an invalid CriticFindings JSON
the completeness critic is run
revision is not triggered
no revision call is made

scenarios.name: SP1-GD-07 critic LLM exception returns empty CriticFindings

steps.text: an LLM that raises a RuntimeError during the critic call
the completeness critic is run
an empty CriticFindings model is returned
a call log entry is appended with stage stage_2
the call log entry step is critic
the call log entry success is false
the call log entry has an error message field

background.text: the STPA system model critic module is importable
a control structure that passed Call 3 validation is available
a capability profile and use-case text are available
a run directory for call logging
